Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de utilaje industriale, Fabricația de mase plastice și Fabricația de ambalaje și recipiente
What You Will Enjoy Doing
 Development
Design, develop and implement complex ERP solutions, focusing on scalability, security and maintainability
Contribute to the technical design of customizations, extensions and integrations within our ERP landscape and Power Platform environment
Develop and maintain plugins, custom workflows, integrations and components using C#, .NET, JavaScript and Web APIs
Architect and implement integrations with Azure services and external systems (e.g. REST APIs, messaging, data synchronization)
Act as a technical advisor for business stakeholders and consultants, translating complex business requirements into robust technical solutions
Review code, define development standards and ensure adherence to best practices and governance guidelines
Support and improve CI/CD pipelines, release management and automated testing using tools such as Azure DevOps
Analyze and resolve complex technical issues, performance challenges and system bottlenecks
Mentor and support junior developers, fostering knowledge sharing and technical excellence within the team
 AI architecture
Work with business and IT stakeholders to identify, evaluate and prioritize AI use cases across the organization and translate them into viable solution concepts
Design the architecture for AI-enabled solutions, both within ERP systems (preferably Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform) and as standalone solutions, e.g. using Microsoft Copilot and Azure AI services
Explore and leverage modern AI technologies and large language models (e.g. Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Claude, Codex) and assess their fit for business use cases
Integrate AI capabilities securely and in line with ALPLA's AI governance and data protection requirements
 What makes you great
 Job holder profile
Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a comparable technical qualification
Several years of hands-on experience in developing and customizing ERP solutions, preferably Microsoft Dynamics 365
Deep expertise in C#, .NET, JavaScript, ERP architecture and customization techniques, preferably with Dynamics 365
Strong experience with Power Platform, Dataverse and Azure services
Solid understanding of solution architecture, integration patterns, security concepts and performance optimization
Knowledge of AI technologies and large language models (e.g. Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI Foundry, Claude, Codex) or a strong willingness to learn in this area
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments and collaborating with cross-functional teams
Proven ability to take technical ownership and drive solutions independently
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured working approach
Excellent communication skills in English (spoken and written); German is a plus
 It is required to act in a safe and environmentally responsible manner at all times by adhering to all ALPLA policies and procedures as well as Safety Standards (OSHA).
 What You Can Expect Working With Us
 Main purpose
The Senior Software Developer & AI Architect – ERP designs, implements and evolves enterprise-grade business solutions within our ERP landscape and Power Platform ecosystem. In addition to hands-on development, the role ensures solution quality and scalability. As AI Architect, the role also works with us on AI use cases across the organization, from identifying and evaluating ideas to designing and implementing AI-enabled solutions, whether within ERP system and the Power Platform or as standalone solutions, using Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI services and other modern AI technologies. The role actively contributes to architectural decisions and best practices across the organization
